extracted.intended_audience: creative marketing and communications professionals, brands, agencies, creators, and prospective Cannes Lions attendees
extracted.subtask_description: Landing/announcement page for the Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity 2026 describing the Festival programme, awards focus and attendee benefits (networking, learning, creator and sport tracks). Useful for understanding what the Festival values and what types of work/participation are highlighted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creativity
rubrics_metrics.description: At Cannes Lions, creativity is everything; the Awards are where the new benchmark for global creative excellence is set each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Festival showcases industry-leading work and thought leaders; attendees should expect talks and awarded work that represent the highest standards of creative excellence. The page repeatedly frames creativity as the principal value and selection axis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Celebrating effectiveness — work that achieves business or communication goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Festival emphasises how global brands use creativity to grow their business and connect with customers, indicating that judged work should demonstrate measurable or persuasive business impact and real-world effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Celebrating innovation — novel approaches, ideas or uses of technology in marketing and communications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programme items (e.g., panels on AI, future of marketing) and award framing point to valuing inventive, forward-looking work that advances the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creative Brand Lion — systems, cultures and capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The new Creative Brand Lion recognises the systems, cultures and capabilities that make world-class creative inevitable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This award dimension looks beyond single outputs to organisational structures and practices that enable outstanding creative work (e.g., processes, culture, capability-building). Submissions/recognition are implied to consider systemic and cultural factors, not just individual campaigns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business impact in sport marketing (LIONS Sport)
rubrics_metrics.description: LIONS Sport is a new two-day programme dedicated to the business of competition and is aimed at people involved in the business of sport marketing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content and awards/recognition in this strand will prioritise sport-marketing work that demonstrates commercial and competitive business outcomes, partnerships and strategies specific to sport.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creator economy and influence (LIONS Creators)
rubrics_metrics.description: LIONS Creators is the pass, programme and place for the creator economy, with access to a beach space, stage, content studio and activations around the business of influence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This track foregrounds creator-led work, influence-driven campaigns and platforms/tools for creators; criteria implied include effectiveness within the creator economy, content production capability, and influencer-driven business outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Networking and global community
rubrics_metrics.description: Building a global community, exchanging and celebrating ideas, and driving growth with like-minded people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Festival values work and participation that enable collaboration, relationship-building and international exchange. Attendee benefit and selection (e.g., speaking, panels) likely favour projects that foster community and cross-border relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learning, access and talent development
rubrics_metrics.description: Learning programmes, grants & scholarships aimed at helping marketers reach their potential and creating opportunities for future creative leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Festival emphasises professional development and access; work or participation linked to mentorship, education, diversity of opportunity, and demonstrable learning outcomes is aligned with the Festival's stated priorities.
